products.name: Janisol
products.generic: steel door and window profile system

evidence.quote: A new JANSEN Q-Bic Plus infiltration and rainwater management system was installed for Opernhaus Zurich’s Kügeliloo warehouse on behalf of the city authorities.
It took only two days to install the retention system with its 550 basket elements. The modular design of the Q-Bic Plus system takes the credit for its quick installation.
the client, the City of Zurich, opted for the sustainable Q-Bic Plus infiltration and retention system.
JANSEN powerwave single-u ground source heat loops were used in order to achieve the required heat output from fewer and shorter boreholes.
The Janisol steel profile system in the form of the Janisol HI window elements used as well as Janisol 2 EI30 fire protection sliding doors cover the requirements
